label: nyiso 39 priced interchange
definition: nyiso-39 closes the keeper-34 -> unified-engine migration: the nyiso-38 recipe (keeper-34-exact offer curve, gas-hub-basis daily+overlay, zonal gas basis, local-selfsupply, energy+reserve co-opt, continuous temperature-ramp reliability floor) plus --priced-interchange, the keeper-34 flag the migration template had silently dropped. Keeper 34's run_config records priced_interchange=true; without it --nyiso-firm-imports and --nyiso-import-reconciliation are hard-gated OFF, so the nyiso-36/37/38 probes silently served the measured EIA-930 schedule as a fixed demand-side subtraction instead of the priced import node + HQ firm floor + monthly reconciliation band - the fixed schedule displaced the un-floored mid-merit downstate steam (the misdiagnosed 'Capital_Hudson economic squeeze'; keeper 34's own model CH ST was 0.16 TWh, not the ~1.2 the handoff claimed - that figure is the CAMPD actual keeper 34 equally under-ran). Restoring the flag clears every hard criterion: 2024 ST_GAS 8.89 -> 9.41 TWh (-1.40 vs rubric band +/-1.50), 2023 CC_REGULAR +2.61 -> +1.06, 2023 ST_GAS -1.30 -> -0.86; C2/C4/C5a hold. Migration fidelity verified value-by-value against keeper sha 180d579 (interchange + reserve unifications byte-faithful for NYISO); one post-keeper measured addition kept per rule #10 (4,350 MW Gold Book simultaneous-import limit). Soft C3a/b/c price caveats persist (ledgered ORDC/reserve-scarcity frontier): 2024/2025 land at keeper-34 levels (C3a -19.2/-13.2% vs -19.4/-13.7%), while 2023 runs deeper (C3a -15.6% vs keeper 34's -8.0%) because the priced-import node's elastic imports soften off-peak prices further than the fixed measured-schedule probe. Verdict NOT-YET (deciding criterion: caveat budget exceeded, hard 0/1 soft 3/2 — the calibration-rubric rebalance in PR #1265 cut the soft-caveat budget 3 -> 2, and this run's 3 ledgered C3 price caveats (C3a mean LMP, C3b price duration/shape, C3c price tail/scarcity) now exceed it; the run itself is unchanged from its original solve, which passed all hard criteria and cleared the wider pre-rebalance caveat budget). Promoted NYISO keeper, replacing the non-reproducible nyiso-34 (legacy floor injectors deleted, solve sha dirty/unrecorded).
